crossRefs.note: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.
So Solomon thrust Abiathar out from being priest to Yahweh, that he might fulfill Yahweh’s word, which he spoke…
“Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in…
I will raise up a faithful priest for myself who will do according to that which is in my heart and in my mind. I will…
Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,
These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering…
Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army; and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
translations.bsb: And the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada in Joab’s place over the army, and he appointed Zadok the priest in Abiathar’s place.
translations.kjv: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
translations.asv: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host; and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
